stories.title: Add Comments to Transaction Details
stories.goal: add comments directly to specific transactions to discuss or react to roster moves
stories.benefit: I can share my thoughts on trades and roster moves with context specific to each transaction
acceptanceCriteria: Comment input field appears on transaction detail view or expanded transaction card
User can write multi-line text comments with basic formatting preserved
Comments display below transaction with author name, role, team affiliation, and timestamp
Comment submission immediately shows comment with author attribution
Character limit enforced with counter display (e.g., 2000 character maximum)

stories.title: Reply to Transaction Comments
stories.goal: reply to specific comments on transactions to maintain conversation threads
stories.benefit: I can have focused discussions about specific transactions and respond directly to other members
acceptanceCriteria: Reply button appears on each transaction comment enabling threaded responses
Replies appear indented below parent comment with visual connection indicator
Threading supports at least 2 levels deep (comment → reply → nested reply)
Reply interface clearly shows which comment user is responding to
Collapsed/expanded state manageable for long conversation threads

stories.title: Add Emoji Reactions to Transactions
stories.goal: quickly react to transactions with emoji without writing full comments
stories.benefit: I can express sentiment about roster moves with minimal effort and see community reaction at a glance
acceptanceCriteria: Reaction picker button appears on each transaction with emoji icon
Clicking picker displays panel with common emoji options (like, fire, thinking, shocked, laughing, etc.)
User can select emoji which displays immediately on transaction card
Reactions show emoji with count and hovering reveals who reacted
User can only add one reaction of each emoji type per transaction

stories.title: Remove Own Reactions from Transactions
stories.goal: remove emoji reactions I added to transactions if my sentiment changes
stories.benefit: I can update my reactions without permanent commitment
acceptanceCriteria: User can click on emoji they previously added to remove their reaction
Reaction count decrements immediately and emoji removed if count reaches zero
Visual indicator shows which reactions current user has added (e.g., highlighted border)
Removing reaction updates engagement metrics for promotion logic
User can remove and re-add same reaction multiple times

stories.title: Display Transaction Engagement Indicators
stories.goal: see comment counts and reaction summaries on transactions in the feed
stories.benefit: I can identify which transactions have generated discussion and gauge community interest
acceptanceCriteria: Comment count badge displays on each transaction card showing total comments
Reaction summary displays top 3-5 most used emoji with counts
Engagement indicators visible on both transaction page and promoted newsfeed moments
Zero-engagement transactions show 'Be the first to comment/react' prompts
Clicking engagement indicators expands or navigates to transaction detail

stories.title: Automatically Promote Engaged Transactions to Newsfeed
stories.goal: create newsfeed moments for transactions that receive significant engagement
stories.benefit: interesting transactions gain broader visibility beyond the transactions page
acceptanceCriteria: System monitors transaction engagement (comments and reactions) in real-time
Transaction automatically promoted to newsfeed when engagement threshold met (e.g., 3+ comments or 5+ reactions)
Promoted transaction appears as moment in newsfeed with 'Transaction' type indicator
Moment includes transaction details and engagement summary in card
Promotion occurs only once per transaction regardless of continued engagement

stories.title: Configure Transaction Promotion Thresholds
stories.goal: adjust the engagement thresholds that trigger automatic transaction promotion to newsfeed
stories.benefit: I can control the balance between transaction visibility and newsfeed noise based on league activity levels
acceptanceCriteria: Admin settings page includes transaction promotion configuration section
Admin can set minimum comment count threshold for promotion (0-10 range)
Admin can set minimum reaction count threshold for promotion (0-20 range)
Admin can disable automatic promotion entirely if desired
Changes to thresholds apply immediately to new engagement without retroactive promotion

stories.title: Link Promoted Transaction Moments to Transaction Page
stories.goal: navigate from promoted transaction moment in newsfeed to full transaction detail page
stories.benefit: I can see complete transaction context and participate in discussion from newsfeed
acceptanceCriteria: Promoted transaction moment in newsfeed includes 'View Transaction' link or card is clickable
Clicking navigates to transaction detail page or opens transaction modal
Navigation preserves context so user can return to newsfeed position
Transaction detail page shows all engagement (comments/reactions) consolidated
Link remains functional even if transaction later filtered from transactions page

stories.title: Track Engagement Metrics for Transaction Analytics
stories.goal: record all engagement activity on transactions for analytics and visibility algorithms
stories.benefit: transaction engagement data can inform future features and help identify league activity patterns
acceptanceCriteria: System logs timestamp for every comment and reaction on transactions
Engagement metrics include unique commenters, total comments, unique reactors, and reaction breakdown
Transaction 'last activity' timestamp updates with each new engagement event
Metrics persist across sessions for historical analysis
Data structure supports future analytics queries (most engaged trades, active traders, etc.)

stories.title: Display Engagement Activity in Transaction Detail View
stories.goal: see all comments and reactions when viewing a transaction in detail
stories.benefit: I can read full discussions and see community sentiment about specific roster moves
acceptanceCriteria: Transaction detail view shows complete comment thread with all replies
Reactions displayed prominently with emoji counts and reactor list on hover
Comments sorted by timestamp (oldest first) with option to sort by most reacted
New comment input field prominently placed for easy participation
Engagement section scrollable independently if transaction details are long

stories.title: Filter Transactions by Engagement Level
stories.goal: filter transaction feed to show only highly engaged or discussed transactions
stories.benefit: I can focus on controversial or interesting moves that generated community discussion
acceptanceCriteria: Transaction page includes engagement filter option (All, Commented, Highly Engaged)
'Commented' filter shows only transactions with at least one comment
'Highly Engaged' filter shows only transactions meeting promotion threshold
Engagement filter works in combination with existing type, team, and time filters
Filter state indicated clearly in UI and persists during session

stories.title: Notification for Comments on My Team's Transactions
stories.goal: receive notifications when league members comment on my team's transactions
stories.benefit: I can defend my roster moves or participate in discussions about my trades and pickups
acceptanceCriteria: Manager receives notification when comment added to transaction involving their team
Notification includes transaction type, teams involved, and comment snippet
Notification links directly to transaction detail with engagement section
User can control notification preferences for transaction engagement alerts
Notification marks as read when user views the transaction comments
